name: know-crm
description: Open-source CRM: leads, sales pipeline, projects, client portal, meetings, invoicing and reports.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @know-crm/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @know-crm/shared" "npm run dev -w @know-crm/api" "npm run dev -w @know-crm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @know-crm/shared && npm run build -w @know-crm/api && npm run build -w @know-crm/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @know-crm/api" "npm run start -w @know-crm/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @know-crm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @know-crm/shared && npm run test -w @know-crm/api
